candidate_ledger.output_variable_reasoning: The target quantity U_tau/U_inf is dimensionless. Using only the supplied dimensional inputs, all independent dimensionless groups that can be formed are functions of (1) a Reynolds number based on outer length scale Re_delta = U_inf*delta/nu (or similarly Re_theta = U_inf*theta/nu), (2) a normalized integrated kinetic energy MKE_norm = MKE/(U_inf^2 * delta) which is dimensionless since MKE has dimensions L^3 T^-2, (3) geometric shape ratios delta*/delta and theta/delta which are dimensionless. Thus the friction-velocity ratio can be written in dimensionless form as U_tau/U_inf = F(Re_delta, MKE/(U_inf^2 delta), delta*/delta, theta/delta).

variables.physical_definition: Free-stream velocity: velocity of the undisturbed flow far from the boundary layer (magnitude of the free-stream)
Kinematic viscosity of the fluid (dynamic viscosity divided by density)
Integrated mean-flow kinetic energy per unit mass across the boundary layer, defined as the integral from the wall to delta of U^2 dy: ∫_0^δ U^2 dy
Boundary-layer thickness at 99% of free-stream: wall-normal distance where mean velocity reaches 0.99 U_inf
Displacement thickness, δ* = ∫_0^δ (1 - U/U_inf) dy (effective thickness reflecting mass flux deficit)
Momentum thickness, θ = ∫_0^δ (U/U_inf)(1 - U/U_inf) dy (measure of momentum deficit)
